lines.text: Two followers walk to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem, and Jesus walks with them unrecognized.
Cleopas tells the stranger that the chief priests and rulers crucified Jesus, whom they had hoped would redeem Israel.
Some women found the tomb empty and told of angels, and companions who went to the tomb did not see Jesus.
Jesus says the Christ had to suffer and enter His glory, beginning with David and all the Prophets.
Jesus breaks bread at the table and disappears, and the two return to Galilee and tell the Eleven what happened.
